reason: I've never heard of Nora Furnish and nothing here says the fixture is UL listed. I'm not putting an unknown $360 pendant over my dining table when my electrician has to sign off on it.
objection: Is it UL listed and safe, and will my electrician install it? There are no lumens, wattage, canopy size, wiring or hanging specs, and I'd pay return shipping on a big pendant if it turns out wrong. A made-to-order wait of 6 weeks would also stall my renovation.
would_change_my_mind: A UL/ETL listing shown on the product page, a full spec sheet (lumens, CRI, wattage, canopy and drop dimensions, install guide), and proof from real customers who installed it, plus free return shipping or a sample.
